title: A child alone
text: {a}, no more than ten, is sitting in the road crying. "I went to find the goat," they sniff, "and now I don't know which way home is."

choices.label: Take them to the next place (two hours)

outcomes.text: {a}'s family sent word of thanks: a loaf and a blessing, and your name in every prayer.

choices.label: Point them toward the nearest roof and walk on

outcomes.text: A shepherd found {a} before dark, and walked them home.
{a} wasn't found until morning, cold and frightened. Somebody on the road walked past.
